name: Machine Learning for 3D Geometry
description:
The lecture will provide the theoretical knowledge of 3D computer vision and recent advances, including the following topics:
- Surface Representations
- Geometry Processing
- Machine Learning Foundations
- Object Segmentation
- Semantic Scene Understanding
- 3D Generative Models
- Scene Reconstruction and Generation
- Neural Rendering
- Dynamics and Interactions in Scenes

Besides the theoretical aspect, the course has a 5-week project phase that will be a key focus. Students should get familiar with implementing and improving deep learning models throughout the process with PyTorch. The project will cover the following topics:
- Neural Rendering
- Scene Understanding
- 3D Generative Models
- Scene Reconstruction

We recommend checking the list of publications at https://www.3dunderstanding.org/publications.html to get a better idea of recent research projects.
prerequisites:
IN2346 Introduction to Deep Learning (expert knowledge required!)
MA0901 Lineare Algebra für Informatiker
